assumptions: Residuals are exchangeable (residual resampling) or observations can be left out without changing the curve's shape.
limits: Measures fitting uncertainty in one reaction, not variation between replicate reactions.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The Curve tab's bootstrap section shows the resampled intervals as a table with no sentence over them; the quantiles are the answer, and a reading composed here would be one nobody reviewed.
bio.jane/contract.question: How tightly do one reaction's observations pin down its Cq, efficiency and fitted coefficients?

description: Resampling error bars on ONE reaction's Cq. A Cq is read off a fitted model, so its uncertainty is how tightly the observations pin that model down - which propagating a measured spread cannot answer. This refits the curve a few hundred times, either by resampling its residuals or by leaving observations out, and reports the spread of everything the fit produces: every model coefficient, the Cq under each definition, the efficiency and the initial fluorescence, each with the quantiles of the iterations rather than a normal approximation, so an asymmetric interval means the estimate genuinely is asymmetric. Reproduces qpcR 1.4.2's `pcrboot`.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

conf_level.description: the level the reported bounds are read at — 0.95 puts them at the 2.5 % and 97.5 % quantiles of the iterations.

cq_method.description: which Cq definition the resampled efficiency readouts report. Values: cpD2 (cpD2 · second-derivative max), cpD1 (cpD1 · first-derivative max), maxE (maxE · cycle of maximum efficiency), expR (expR · exponential region), Cy0 (Cy0 · tangent x-intercept (Guescini)), CQ (CQ · 20 % of the Cq fluorescence), maxRatio (maxRatio · spline, model-free (Shain)).

curves.description: the amplification table: a header row, first column the cycle number and every other column one reaction's fluorescence. The same parser `call_cq` and the Curve->Cq tab use.

drop.description: jackknife only: observations left out of each refit. 1 is the delete-one jackknife; more is a delete-d jackknife, which is less sensitive to a single influential cycle. Only applies when scheme is jack.

include_readouts.description: also resample every efficiency readout — the Cq definitions, the efficiency, the initial fluorescence — not just the model coefficients. On, because an interval on the Cq is the point; off is faster and returns coefficients alone. Advanced.

iterations.description: each iteration is a full nonlinear refit, so this is the run's whole cost. 100 is upstream's default and puts a 95 % bound on a single order statistic, which is why both doors open on 200.

model.description: the sigmoid fitted once and REFITTED on every iteration. It is not re-chosen per resample: Cqs fitted under different models are not comparable, so a mixture over models would make the quantiles mean nothing. Values: l4 (l4 · 4-param log-logistic), l5 (l5 · + asymmetry), l6 (l6 · + linear baseline drift), l7 (l7 · + quadratic baseline), b4 (b4 · 4-param logistic (raw scale)), b5 (b5 · + asymmetry), b6 (b6 · + linear baseline drift), b7 (b7 · + quadratic baseline).

reaction.description: which reaction to resample, by its column name. Blank takes the first column — this is a per-reaction run by design, because at the default 200 iterations a 47-reaction plate would be 9,400 refits nobody asked for.

scheme.description: `boot` resamples the fit's residuals (upstream's default); `jack` leaves observations out. The bootstrap answers "how would this Cq move under the same noise?", the jackknife "how much does any single cycle carry it?".

seed.description: R's `set.seed` value, so the interval is reproducible and citable. Advanced.

name: bootstrap_cq

coefficients.description: one row per model coefficient, in the model's own parameter order, same fields

confLevel.description: the level the bounds above are read at

converged.description: iterations whose refit converged — the ONLY ones any number here is computed from. Well below `iterations` is a finding about the curve, not a warning to swallow

model.description: the model refitted on every iteration

reaction.description: the reaction actually resampled, named — "the first column" is not a citation

readouts.description: one row per resampled readout — Cq under each definition, efficiency, initial fluorescence — with mean, SD, median and the interval quantiles. Empty when `include_readouts` is off

rmse.description: residual standard error across the iterations

rss.description: residual sum of squares across the iterations
